Chronologie fondatrice

5 événements vérifiés.

Chaque entrée ci-dessous remonte à une source canonique et conserve son niveau de confiance.

27 juin 2024
Digit humanoid logistics robot

GXO and Agility announce multi-year commercial deployment of Digit

GXO and Agility Robotics announced a multi-year agreement on June 27, 2024 for Digit humanoid robots in a live warehouse tote-handling workflow.

Institution · niveau B
12 oct. 2023
Open X-Embodiment / RT-X

Open X-Embodiment aggregates data across many robot platforms

The Open X-Embodiment preprint reported a cross-institution dataset spanning 22 robot embodiments and policies showing positive cross-robot transfer.

Prépublication · niveau B
28 juil. 2023
RT-2

RT-2 transfers web knowledge into robotic actions

The RT-2 preprint reported improved robotic generalization and semantic reasoning by co-training robot actions with web-scale vision-language data.

Prépublication · niveau B
6 mars 2023
PaLM-E

PaLM-E demonstrates multi-embodiment multimodal transfer

The PaLM-E preprint described one embodied multimodal model trained across multiple embodied tasks and robot embodiments while retaining language capabilities.

Prépublication · niveau B
13 déc. 2022
RT-1

RT-1 scales a single robot policy across hundreds of tasks

The RT-1 preprint reported a single transformer policy trained on more than 130,000 real-robot episodes spanning more than 700 tasks and 13 robots.

Prépublication · niveau B
